name: engram
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code. Connect to a configured Engram server with its URL; a worker keycard is needed when server authentication is enabled. Never place the server operator key (ENGRAM_AUTH_ADMIN_TOKEN) on a workstation.

api_token.title: API Token (when server authentication is enabled)
api_token.description: Worker keycard issued from the Engram dashboard /access page for an auth-enabled server. Leave unset for an auth-disabled server; never use the server operator key on a workstation.

engram_quiet.title: Quiet mode (mute automatic hook injection)
engram_quiet.description: When enabled, engram stops PUSHING context into the prompt: no session-start behavioral rules / memories / issues, no pre-tool-use or pre-compact context. Capture/learning hooks still run (the memory keeps crystallizing lessons and recording outcomes), and MCP tools are unaffected — quiet stops engram talking, not learning. Use when injected context is more noise than signal. (Codex ≥0.139 does not forward this to hook children — set "quiet": true in ~/.engram/config.json there instead.)
